notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד i tanim olsem khesed long tpi, i no 'marimari' tasol — em i khet wantaim stret pasin na marimari

notes.subject: olgenereisen
notes.rationale: דר em i 'ol man bilong wanpela taim' — 'olgenereisen' em i tok Inglis planti, tasol Tok Pisin i usim

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Saposa bilong em — Hibru i gat satvik ⟨suffix⟩ long חסדו na אמונתו

notes.subject: דר ודר
notes.rationale: Tok i kam bek tupela taim — pasin bilong Hibru bilong tok olsem, em i stap

translation: Bihain Yahwe i gutpela, khesed bilong ⟨em⟩ i stap olgeta taim, na inap long ol olgenereisen na olgenereisen, emiuna bilong ⟨em⟩ i stap.
